verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships device-management software, the nitropy CLI and the NetHSM REST API, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product accepting natural-language commands. The nitropy CLI and the NetHSM OpenAPI/REST interface are structured interfaces, which are only adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
